other_conditions: Applicant must be working in an establishment registered under the Punjab Labour Welfare Fund Act, 1965 and have regular contributions to the labour welfare fund
Applicant must have been a member of the Chandigarh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board for at least 6 months
Beneficiary must not have previously claimed similar benefits under Central or State government schemes
If both father and daughter work in the same establishment, the benefit will be granted to only one of them
A valid Marriage Registration Certificate must be produced
Benefit is limited to two daughters per applicant
Application must be submitted within three months from the date of marriage
Female registered workers are eligible to receive the benefit on the eve of their own self‑marriage
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹21,000 is provided to registered workers on the marriage of their daughter or for the self‑marriage of female workers.
